# conjur_secrets (Data Source)

Secrets from CyberArk Secrets Manager. Read using batch secret retrieval capabilities.

~> **Note:** The retrieved secret values are stored **in plaintext** in the Terraform state (and in saved plan files). Marking `values` as sensitive only redacts it from CLI output. Unless you need the values to be persisted, use the [`conjur_secrets` ephemeral resource](../ephemeral-resources/secrets.md) (`ephemeral "conjur_secrets"`) instead, which never stores the values in state or plan files.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "conjur_secrets" "batch" {
  names = [
    "data/test/var-1",
    "data/test/var-2",
    "data/test/var-3"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `names` (List of String) list of names (paths) of the secrets (between 1 and 250 entries)

### Optional

- `fail_on_error` (Boolean) Determines whether a non-success status code in one of the retrieved secrets (or a secret missing from the response) should fail the whole read. Defaults to true, matching the single-secret conjur_secret data source: any secret that can't be retrieved fails the read. If set to false, only a warning is displayed for each secret that couldn't be retrieved, and that secret is omitted from values.

### Read-Only

- `values` (Map of String, Sensitive) Map of retrieved secret values, keyed by secret name (path) as requested (the batch API echoes each requested identifier back verbatim)
